role: A no-lookahead half-month oil strategy that converts the published two-contract forecast into capacity-constrained named-contract positions and mark-to-market reports.
invariants: strategy decisions read only the current visible futures payload, current published forecast, and current account state
configured institution capability scores are research metadata and never enter signal or position sizing formulas
the signal trusts published forecast centers and bounds by combining current band location with coherent path direction
hidden future bars and future market payloads are unavailable to the decision function
positions exist only in named OIL-YYMM contracts and never in the continuous main index
normal execution uses a fixed 50 percent target adjustment speed and no more than 50 percent of the published per-turn trade limit
mandatory risk reduction has priority and may use the full published per-turn trade limit
aggregate execution prices use only weeks first realized after the decision cutoff and contain no fees or friction in v1
the strategy never changes futures prices, market volume, market open interest, the forecast, or global macro rows
